next_step: Kick off 2-week POC; run streaming vs incumbent benchmark; provide Dedicated pricing
notes:
Account: Nimbus ChatWorks — mid-market B2B SaaS (customer support + task automation). Evaluating Redwood Hosted API as first step, with potential move to Dedicated for predictable throughput and VPC peering.

Reason for outreach: migrating from incumbent LLM API (primary complaint: recent latency regressions on streaming endpoints causing degraded UX and intermittent timeouts). Quote from CTO on 2025-01-10 call: "We saw 30-40% increase in tail streaming latency in Jan; sessions time out when agents call tools. Need stable TTFB and consistent chunked streaming."

POC ask / requirements:
- Workload: multi-turn chat/agent conversations with tool-calling (external API enrichments), average 6-8 turns, ~1.2k tokens/session.
- Targets: P95 streaming TTFB < 250ms, P99 < 600ms for small tokens; end-to-end tool call latency < 500ms ideally.
- Scale: simulate 100 concurrent agent sessions (peak), baseline traffic ~20k conv/month; forecast to 150k conv/month in 12 months.
- Feature needs: chunked streaming, function/tool calling support (structured function outputs), prefix/KV caching, per-route quotas, audit logs and SSO.

Benchmark plan discussed: Redwood to run side-by-side streaming tests vs incumbent (OpenAI) using Nimbus test harness (attached drive test plan). Metrics: time-to-first-byte (TTFB), token-per-second throughput, chunk sizes, reorder/latency of tool-calls, error/retry rate. Nimbus will provide synthetic traces and a small sample of anonymized prompts.

Commercial: mid-market price sensitivity — want Dedicated pricing for committed throughput and example amortized per-conversation unit. Asking for 12-month committed quote with ramp.

Security: SOC2 required, SSO (SAML), audit logs retention 1 year, optional KMS integration for Dedicated. Also asked about data residency (EU customers) — will need clarification for EU-only customers.

Other notes: initial demo 2024-12-18 (hosted streaming + tool demo). Follow-up benchmark review 2025-01-10. POC kickoff planned 2025-01-20 (2 weeks). AE/SE to provide test harness, Redwood to supply streaming endpoints and instrumentation.

Known risks / objections: procurement needs finance sign-off (mid-Q1), engineering wants deeper perf traces (rtsp-like streaming traces), and legal flagged data residency for EU pilot.
